sys_cb_topic.description: Allows users to check a patient's details and discharge status using a Patient ID, assess medical readiness for discharge, identify blocked discharge tasks, view blocker reasons, and find the responsible hospital department or team. When all required readiness checks pass, the assistant updates the patient's status to Discharge in Progress.
sys_cb_topic.name: patient_readiness_assistant
sys_cb_topic.title: Patient Readiness Assistant
